title: Are Video Models Zero-Shot Learners and Reasoners in Education? EduVideoBench, A Knowledge-Skills-Attitude Benchmark for Educational Video Generation
reasoning: The paper introduces EduVideoBench, which includes 'Attitude' as one of its three core dimensions. This dimension specifically benchmarks the model's 'ethical stance' through categories like 'Non-maleficence' (checking for harmful, violent, or exploitative content) and 'Epistemic Stance'.
